nodes.description: What the surface looks like, lit by the engine. A material has one output: this or Custom Lighting Output.
nodes.label: Material Output

nodes.description: The colour the surface shows, worked out by the graph itself (with Main Light and Other Lights) instead of the engine's lighting.
nodes.label: Custom Lighting Output

nodes.description: The main light at this point (the sun when there is one): the direction towards it, its colour and strength, and how much of it the shadows let through (1 lit).
nodes.label: Main Light

nodes.description: The light every other light gives this point, added up (facing them, past shadows).
nodes.label: Other Lights

nodes.description: From the point towards the camera.
nodes.label: View Direction

nodes.description: Where the pixel is on the screen, 0 to 1 from the top left, as a vector (x, y, 0).
nodes.label: Screen Position

nodes.description: How much two directions agree: 1 the same, 0 at right angles, −1 opposite (for unit vectors).
nodes.label: Dot Product

nodes.description: The same direction with length 1.
nodes.label: Normalize

nodes.description: 0 below the edge, 1 from the edge up: a hard band.
nodes.label: Step

nodes.description: 0 below Low, 1 above High, a smooth curve between: a soft band.
nodes.label: Smooth Step

nodes.description: Cuts values from 0 to 1 into a number of flat bands (2 or more).
nodes.label: Posterize

nodes.description: Moves a value from one range to another: From Low becomes To Low and From High To High.
nodes.label: Remap

nodes.description: A fixed number.
nodes.label: Number

nodes.description: A fixed colour.
nodes.label: Color

nodes.description: A vector from three numbers.
nodes.label: Make Vector

nodes.description: The three numbers of a vector or colour.
nodes.label: Split Vector

nodes.description: The colour set on the object's Mesh component.
nodes.label: Object Color

nodes.description: Seconds since the view started; animates the material.
nodes.label: Time

nodes.description: Where the pixel is in the world.
nodes.label: World Position

nodes.description: Where on the shape's surface the pixel is: 0 to 1 across each face, as a vector (u, v, 0).
nodes.label: Texture Coordinates

nodes.description: Colours from a PNG image, laid over the surface by its texture coordinates.
nodes.label: Image

nodes.description: Which way the surface faces, in world space.
nodes.label: Normal

nodes.description: 1 where the surface turns away from the viewer, 0 where it faces them.
nodes.label: Edge Glow

nodes.description: A + B.
nodes.label: Add

nodes.description: A − B.
nodes.label: Subtract

nodes.description: A × B.
nodes.label: Multiply

nodes.description: A ÷ B.
nodes.label: Divide

nodes.description: Linear interpolation (a blend): from A (factor 0) to B (factor 1) on a straight line; factors outside 0 to 1 go past A or B.
nodes.label: Lerp

nodes.description: Where the value lies from A to B: 0 at A, 1 at B, 0.5 halfway, and past 0 or 1 beyond them; 0 when A and B are equal.
nodes.label: Inverse Lerp

nodes.description: Base to the power of the exponent.
nodes.label: Power

nodes.description: The number that times itself gives the input (0 below 0); for a vector, of each part.
nodes.label: Square Root

nodes.description: How long a vector is: the distance from 0 to the point it names.
nodes.label: Vector Length

nodes.description: 1 − the input.
nodes.label: One Minus

nodes.description: Keeps the input between 0 and 1.
nodes.label: Clamp 0 to 1

nodes.description: The sine of the input, in radians.
nodes.label: Sine

nodes.description: Alternating 0 and 1 cubes in space.
nodes.label: Checker

nodes.description: Smooth random values between 0 and 1.
nodes.label: Noise

nodes.description: Noise in layers, each finer and fainter than the one before: Smooth for clouds and terrain, Ridged for sharp crests, Billowy for puffy shapes. Detail is how many layers (1 to 8), Roughness how strong each finer one is, Lacunarity how much finer.
nodes.label: Fractal Noise

nodes.description: Cells round scattered points: Distance to the nearest point (0 at it), Edge (0 on a border between cells), and a random value 0 to 1 for each cell. Randomness 0 lines the points up in a grid.
nodes.label: Voronoi

nodes.description: Soft stripes from 0 to 1: Bands along X, or Rings round the centre. Distortion bends them with noise.
nodes.label: Waves

nodes.description: 0 to 1 across the coordinates: Linear along X, Quadratic (eased), Spherical (1 at the middle, 0 half a unit away) or Radial (round the middle); the middle is X and Y 0.5, the centre of texture coordinates.
nodes.label: Gradient

nodes.description: A different random value 0 to 1 for every point (white noise), and a random colour; Scale sets how fine.
nodes.label: Random

nodes.description: Runs once when the object is ready, before any script's On Start: every script of the scene runs On Init first.
nodes.label: On Init

nodes.description: Runs once when play mode starts, after every script ran On Init.
nodes.label: On Start

nodes.description: Runs every simulation step.
nodes.label: On Update

nodes.description: Runs when a script sends this message to this object, or to every object. Value is the number sent with it.
nodes.label: On Message

nodes.description: Runs when another collider comes into this object's trigger, or this object comes into another's (needs physics).
nodes.label: On Trigger Entered

nodes.description: Runs when another collider leaves this object's trigger, or this object leaves another's (needs physics).
nodes.label: On Trigger Left

nodes.description: Runs when this object's collider starts touching another (needs physics).
nodes.label: On Collision Started

nodes.description: Runs when this object's collider stops touching another (needs physics).
nodes.label: On Collision Ended

nodes.description: Sends a message and a number to the scripts of the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, else every object. It arrives after this step.
nodes.label: Send Message

nodes.description: An input action's value by its kind (a trigger 1 in the step it goes down, held 1 while down, value how far it is pressed), and whether it is down. Name it Jump for the active map, or Player/Jump; actions of maps that are not active read 0.
nodes.label: Action

nodes.description: Runs once in the step an input action goes down, while its map is active.
nodes.label: On Action Pressed

nodes.description: Runs once in the step when the key goes down (names like W, Space, ArrowUp).
nodes.label: On Key Pressed

nodes.description: Runs every given number of seconds of play.
nodes.label: On Timer

nodes.description: Keeps a vector under a name, for this script on this object. It starts where the Variables panel says, or at 0, 0, 0.
nodes.label: Set Vector Variable

nodes.description: The vector Set Vector Variable last kept under this name, or 0, 0, 0.
nodes.label: Vector Variable

nodes.description: Keeps true or false under a name, for this script on this object. It starts as the Variables panel says, or false.
nodes.label: Set True/False Variable

nodes.description: What Set True/False Variable last kept under this name, or false.
nodes.label: True/False Variable

nodes.description: Keeps a whole number under a name, for this script on this object. It starts where the Variables panel says, or at 0.
nodes.label: Set Whole Number Variable

nodes.description: The whole number Set Whole Number Variable last kept under this name, or what it starts at.
nodes.label: Whole Number Variable

nodes.description: Keeps text under a name, for this script on this object (up to 1024 bytes; longer text is cut). It starts as the Variables panel says, or empty.
nodes.label: Set Text Variable

nodes.description: The text Set Text Variable last kept under this name, or what it starts as.
nodes.label: Text Variable

nodes.description: Keeps an object under a name, for this script on this object, from step to step. It starts as none.
nodes.label: Set Object Variable

nodes.description: The object Set Object Variable last kept under this name; none (Found false) before that, or once the object is gone.
nodes.label: Object Variable

nodes.description: Keeps a colour under a name, for this script on this object. It starts as the Variables panel says, or white.
nodes.label: Set Color Variable

nodes.description: The colour Set Color Variable last kept under this name, or what it starts as.
nodes.label: Color Variable

nodes.description: Keeps a number under a name, for this script on this object. It starts where the Variables panel says, or at 0.
nodes.label: Set Variable

nodes.description: The number Set Variable last kept under this name, or 0.
nodes.label: Variable

nodes.description: Writes the message, and the value if one is linked, to the console.
nodes.label: Log

nodes.description: Moves the object to a position (relative to its parent).
nodes.label: Set Position

nodes.description: Moves the object by an offset.
nodes.label: Move By

nodes.description: Sets the rotation, in degrees about X, Y and Z.
nodes.label: Set Rotation

nodes.description: Turns the object by degrees about X, Y and Z.
nodes.label: Rotate By

nodes.description: Sets the size along X, Y and Z.
nodes.label: Set Scale

nodes.description: Continues with True or False, depending on the condition.
nodes.label: Branch

nodes.description: A fixed number.
nodes.label: Number

nodes.description: A vector from three numbers.
nodes.label: Make Vector

nodes.description: The three numbers of a vector.
nodes.label: Split Vector

nodes.description: A number property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default in the script's panel.
nodes.label: Property

nodes.description: A whole-number property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default.
nodes.label: Whole Number Property

nodes.description: A true/false property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default.
nodes.label: True/False Property

nodes.description: A vector property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default.
nodes.label: Vector Property

nodes.description: A colour property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default.
nodes.label: Color Property

nodes.description: A text property: set per object in the Inspector, else its default.
nodes.label: Text Property

nodes.description: An object property: the object of the scene chosen per object in the Inspector (by its name); none (Found false) when none is chosen or it is not there.
nodes.label: Object Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's number property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's whole-number property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Whole Number Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's true/false property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set True/False Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's vector property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Vector Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's colour property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Color Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's text property on this object, for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Text Property

nodes.description: Sets this script's object property on this object to the linked object (by its name), for the rest of play.
nodes.label: Set Object Property

nodes.description: Where a function's actions begin; its outputs are the values the function is called with.
nodes.label: Function

nodes.description: Ends the function and gives back its outputs to the Call Function that ran it.
nodes.label: Return

nodes.description: Runs a function of this script with its inputs, then goes on; its outputs are what the function gave back.
nodes.label: Call Function

nodes.description: Runs when the event is triggered on this object (by a script's Trigger Event, by the interface, or by every object's); its outputs are the values the event brings.
nodes.label: On Event

nodes.description: Triggers an event with its values on the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, else every object; their On Event nodes run after this step.
nodes.label: Trigger Event

nodes.description: This script, as a component of its object: what other scripts trigger events on and subscribe to.
nodes.label: This Component

nodes.description: The object a component is on, or none.
nodes.label: Object of Component

nodes.description: Triggers an event its script declares on one component (a script on an object), with its values; the script's On Event, and the scripts subscribed to it, run after this step. The event is picked from the script's own list.
nodes.label: Trigger Component Event

nodes.description: From now on, this script hears the event whenever it happens on the component, with On Component Event; once per component and event.
nodes.label: Subscribe to Event

nodes.description: Stops this script hearing the event of the component it subscribed to.
nodes.label: Unsubscribe from Event

nodes.description: Runs when the event happens on a component this script subscribed to; Source is that component, and the other outputs are the values the event brings.
nodes.label: On Component Event

nodes.description: The list itself, to pass on: into a list node, a function or an event.
nodes.label: Get List

nodes.description: Puts the value at the end of the list: the one linked in, else the one named.
nodes.label: Add to List

nodes.description: Puts the value in the list at the index (from 0), moving the items from there on along; an index past the end does nothing.
nodes.label: Insert into List

nodes.description: Replaces the list's item at the index (from 0); an index past the end does nothing.
nodes.label: Set List Item

nodes.description: Takes the item at the index (from 0) out of the list; the items after it move back.
nodes.label: Remove from List

nodes.description: Takes every item out of the list.
nodes.label: Clear List

nodes.description: The list's item at the index (from 0). Past the end, Found is false and the value is empty.
nodes.label: List Item

nodes.description: How many items the list holds.
nodes.label: List Length

nodes.description: The index of the first item equal to the value, or -1 when there is none.
nodes.label: Find in List

nodes.description: Runs Each once for every item of the list, in order, with the item and its index (from 0); then runs Then. Items added or taken out on the way count.
nodes.label: For Each in List

nodes.description: The map itself, to pass on: into a map node, a function or an event.
nodes.label: Get Map

nodes.description: Keeps the value under the key, in place of what was there, in the map linked in, else the one named.
nodes.label: Set Map Value

nodes.description: Takes the key, and its value, out of the map.
nodes.label: Remove from Map

nodes.description: Takes every key out of the map.
nodes.label: Clear Map

nodes.description: The value under the key. When the map has no such key, Found is false and the value is empty.
nodes.label: Map Value

nodes.description: How many keys the map holds.
nodes.label: Map Count

nodes.description: Runs Each once for every key of the map, in the keys' order (sorted by their characters), with the key and its value; then runs Then. Keys added or taken out on the way count.
nodes.label: For Each in Map

nodes.description: The object's position, relative to its parent.
nodes.label: Position

nodes.description: The object's rotation in degrees.
nodes.label: Rotation

nodes.description: The object's size along X, Y and Z.
nodes.label: Scale

nodes.description: Seconds since play mode started.
nodes.label: Time

nodes.description: Where the pointer is over the game view, from -1 to 1 (x right, y up), whether it is over the view, and whether it is over an interface element that takes it (its clicks are then the interface's, not the game's).
nodes.label: Pointer Position

nodes.description: True while the mouse button (Left, Right or Middle) is held.
nodes.label: Mouse Button Held

nodes.description: The position of the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name (relative to its parent).
nodes.label: Position Of

nodes.description: Moves the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, to a position.
nodes.label: Set Position Of

nodes.description: Places a copy of a prefab file at a world position, after this step.
nodes.label: Spawn Prefab

nodes.description: The object this script runs on.
nodes.label: This Object

nodes.description: The fields of a data file (.bdata) as it was saved when play started, each the shape's default where the file sets none. The fields are the chosen shape's; lists and maps have no pin.
nodes.label: Data File

nodes.description: The first object with this name, in hierarchy order, as the step began. Found is false when there is none.
nodes.label: Find Object Named

nodes.description: An object that has a component (Point Light, Character…), a tag, or runs a script (by its name), in hierarchy order as the step began: Index 0 is the first. Found is false when there is none.
nodes.label: Find Object With

nodes.description: How many objects have a component (Point Light, Character…), a tag, or run a script (by its name), as the step began.
nodes.label: Count Objects With

nodes.description: Runs Each once for every object that has a component, a tag, or runs a script, in hierarchy order as the step began, with that object and its index (from 0); then runs Then.
nodes.label: For Each Object With

nodes.description: Deletes the linked object (else this object) and its children after this step.
nodes.label: Destroy Object

nodes.description: The fields of a component on the linked object (else this object), as the step began. A missing component reads as zeros; Try Get Component says whether it was found.
nodes.label: Get Component

nodes.description: The fields of a component on the linked object (else this object), as the step began, and whether the object has it.
nodes.label: Try Get Component

nodes.description: Sets the linked fields of a component on the linked object (else this object), after this step. Fields without a link keep their values.
nodes.label: Set Component

nodes.description: Plays the Audio Source of the linked object (else this object), after this step.
nodes.label: Play Sound

nodes.description: Stops the sounds the linked object (else this object) plays, after this step.
nodes.label: Stop Sound

nodes.description: Plays the Keyframe Animation of the linked object (else this object) from its start, after this step.
nodes.label: Play Keyframe Animation

nodes.description: Stops the Keyframe Animation of the linked object (else this object) where it is, after this step.
nodes.label: Stop Keyframe Animation

nodes.description: Plays a sound file once from a world position, after this step, heard from the first camera.
nodes.label: Play Sound At

nodes.description: After this step, loads a scene file: in place of the playing scene (every script starts again; the game's values stay), or, with Add to This Scene, its objects join this one and Unload Scene removes them again.
nodes.label: Load Scene

nodes.description: After this step, removes the objects of the scenes added from this file while playing.
nodes.label: Unload Scene

nodes.description: Deletes this object and its children after this step.
nodes.label: Destroy This Object

nodes.description: A number the game keeps under a name: the game's own (Scope Game), a player's (Scope Player: the object named in Player, else the first player) or this object's (Scope This Object, when it has Player Control); Scope Saved keeps it from one play to the next, as for a best score. Nothing is set at first: Value is 0 and Is Set is false until something sets it.
nodes.label: Game Value

nodes.description: Keeps a number under a name in the game's state or a player's (see Game Value for the scopes).
nodes.label: Set Game Value

nodes.description: Adds an amount to a number in the game's state or a player's; a name not set yet counts as 0.
nodes.label: Change Game Value

nodes.description: Makes another map of an Input Map active (Player, Menu…): the project's, or this object's own when it has an Input Map component. Only the active map's actions work.
nodes.label: Set Input Map

nodes.description: Ends the game, won or lost; every script then gets the message gameWon or gameLost. Only the first ending counts.
nodes.label: End Game

nodes.description: Starts the Particle Emitter of the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, else this object's: a new cycle, with its burst. After this step.
nodes.label: Play Particles

nodes.description: Stops the emitter starting particles; those alive live out their lives. Which emitter: as Play Particles.
nodes.label: Stop Particles

nodes.description: Starts Count particles at once from the emitter (as many as it has room for). Which emitter: as Play Particles.
nodes.label: Burst Particles

nodes.description: Plays the clip named in Clip on the model of the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, else this object, fading from what played over Fade seconds (0 to 60). After this step.
nodes.label: Play Clip

nodes.description: Fades the model to its rest pose over Fade seconds. Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Stop Clip

nodes.description: Sets the number parameter named in Parameter, which mixes and animation states read. Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Set Animation Number

nodes.description: Sets the true/false parameter named in Parameter. Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Set Animation Flag

nodes.description: Sets the trigger named in Parameter, which the first transition it lets through uses up. Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Trigger Animation

nodes.description: The animation state the object is in, as of the last step (empty, and In States false, when it runs none). Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Animation State

nodes.description: Where the joint named in Joint of the object's model is in the world, as the last step posed it (Found is false when the object is not animated or has no such joint). Which object: as Play Clip.
nodes.label: Joint Position

nodes.description: Runs when the player presses the button named in Element, in this object's Interface.
nodes.label: On Interface Pressed

nodes.description: Runs when the player changes the toggle, slider or text field named in Element, in this object's Interface. Value is its new value (a text field's length).
nodes.label: On Interface Changed

nodes.description: Sets the text of the element named in Element, in the Interface of the linked object, else the first object named in Object Name, else this object. It shows after this step.
nodes.label: Set Interface Text

nodes.description: Sets an element's value: a toggle's state (0 or 1), a slider's number, a progress bar's fill (0 to 1). Which interface: as Set Interface Text.
nodes.label: Set Interface Value

nodes.description: Shows or hides the element named in Element, or the whole interface when Element is empty. Which interface: as Set Interface Text.
nodes.label: Show Interface

nodes.description: Builds the interface while the game plays: adds an element named Name into the element named in Into (the root when empty). What is a kind (button, text, progress...) or a layout file (.bui) used as a part, whose elements are then named Name/element.
nodes.label: Add Interface Element

nodes.description: The value of the element named in Element as it shows now: a toggle's 0 or 1, a slider's number, a bound game value. Found is false when the interface has no such element. Which interface: the linked object's, else the first object named in Object Name, else this object's.
nodes.label: Interface Value

nodes.description: The text of the element named in Element as it shows now, what the player typed into a text field too; empty when there is no such element. Which interface: as Interface Value.
nodes.label: Interface Text

nodes.description: Removes the element named Name, with what it holds. Which interface: as Set Interface Text.
nodes.label: Remove Interface Element

nodes.description: Sets a character's walking velocity (the linked object, else the first one named in Object Name, else this object), in world units per second, until changed.
nodes.label: Walk

nodes.description: Makes a character on the ground jump with an upward speed (the linked object, else the first one named in Object Name, else this object).
nodes.label: Jump

nodes.description: True while this object's character stands on something.
nodes.label: On Ground

nodes.description: Pushes a physics body (the linked object, else the first one named in Object Name, else this object) by an impulse in world space, after this step.
nodes.label: Add Impulse

nodes.description: Sets a physics body's velocity (the linked object, else the first one named in Object Name, else this object), in world units per second, after this step.
nodes.label: Set Velocity

nodes.description: This object's physics velocity as the step began (0 without a body).
nodes.label: Velocity

nodes.description: Sends a ray from Origin along Direction, up to Distance, and says whether it hits another object's shape or sprite, how far, and where.
nodes.label: Cast Ray

nodes.description: Where a gamepad stick (Left or Right) points, from -1 to 1 (x right, y up); 0 without a gamepad.
nodes.label: Gamepad Stick

nodes.description: How far a gamepad trigger (Left or Right) is pressed, from 0 to 1.
nodes.label: Gamepad Trigger

nodes.description: True while the gamepad button is held: South, East, West, North, LeftBumper, RightBumper, Select, Start, Up, Down, Left, Right and others.
nodes.label: Gamepad Button Held

nodes.description: True while the key is held (names like W, Space, ArrowUp).
nodes.label: Key Held

nodes.description: A + B.
nodes.label: Add

nodes.description: A − B.
nodes.label: Subtract

nodes.description: A × B.
nodes.label: Multiply

nodes.description: The value with its sign turned: 5 becomes −5 and −5 becomes 5; a vector points the other way.
nodes.label: Negate

nodes.description: A ÷ B.
nodes.label: Divide

nodes.description: The sine of the input, in radians.
nodes.label: Sine

nodes.description: Base to the power of the exponent: whole numbers stay whole (a negative exponent gives 0, or ±1 for 1 and −1); for a vector, each part.
nodes.label: Power

nodes.description: The number that times itself gives the input (0 below 0); for a vector, of each part.
nodes.label: Square Root

nodes.description: How long a vector is: the distance from 0 to the point it names.
nodes.label: Vector Length

nodes.description: The vector's direction at length 1: a move as fast diagonally as straight. A vector of length 0 stays 0, so a player standing still stays still.
nodes.label: Normalize

nodes.description: Linear interpolation: from A (factor 0) to B (factor 1) on a straight line; factors outside 0 to 1 go past A or B. For vectors, each part.
nodes.label: Lerp

nodes.description: Where the value lies from A to B: 0 at A, 1 at B, 0.5 halfway, and past 0 or 1 beyond them; 0 when A and B are equal.
nodes.label: Inverse Lerp

nodes.description: A when the condition is true, otherwise B.
nodes.label: Choose

nodes.description: True when A > B.
nodes.label: Greater Than

nodes.description: True when both are true.
nodes.label: And

nodes.description: True when either is true.
nodes.label: Or

nodes.description: True when the input is false.
nodes.label: Not

nodes.description: A whole number typed here.
nodes.label: Whole Number

nodes.description: A number made whole: Nearest (halves away from zero), Down, Up or Toward Zero. Numbers past the 32-bit range stop at its ends.
nodes.label: To Whole Number

nodes.description: What is left after dividing A by B as whole numbers (its sign is A's); 0 when B is 0.
nodes.label: Remainder

nodes.description: Text typed here.
nodes.label: Text

nodes.description: A followed by B.
nodes.label: Join Text

nodes.description: How many characters the text has.
nodes.label: Text Length

nodes.description: A number (up to three decimals), a whole number (every digit) or a vector, as (x, y, z), written as text.
nodes.label: To Text

nodes.description: The number the text spells, such as -2.5 (spaces around it are fine). Valid is false, and the number 0, when it spells none.
nodes.label: Text to Number

nodes.description: True when A and B are the same text (upper and lower case differ).
nodes.label: Same Text

nodes.description: True when Part appears in the text.
nodes.label: Text Contains

nodes.description: True when the text begins with Part.
nodes.label: Starts With

nodes.description: True when the text ends with Part.
nodes.label: Ends With

nodes.description: Where Part first appears in the text, counted in characters from 0; -1 when it does not.
nodes.label: Find in Text

nodes.description: Count characters of the text from Start (0 is the first), cut short at its end.
nodes.label: Part of Text

nodes.description: The text with every Find replaced by With.
nodes.label: Replace Text

nodes.description: The text with a to z made A to Z.
nodes.label: Upper Case

nodes.description: The text with A to Z made a to z.
nodes.label: Lower Case

nodes.description: The text without spaces, tabs and line breaks at its start and end.
nodes.label: Trim Text

nodes.description: The name of the linked object, else this object.
nodes.label: Name Of

nodes.description: The state an object starts in. Without one, it starts in the first state.
nodes.label: Start State

nodes.description: A state the object can be in, by its name, playing the motion linked in (at rest when none is).
nodes.label: State

nodes.description: Goes from one state (or, with From left empty, from any other) to another while When is true, fading over Fade seconds. Transitions are tried in the order they were placed.
nodes.label: Transition

nodes.description: One of the model's clips by name, at a speed, looping or once.
nodes.label: Clip

nodes.description: A and B by where By lies from At A to At B (walk and run by speed, aiming up and down by angle); before At A all A, past At B all B. Both play in step. Link a Mix into A or B to mix more.
nodes.label: Mix

nodes.description: Top over Base on the joint named Joint and every joint under it (a wave on the arm while the legs walk), by Weight from 0 to 1.
nodes.label: Layer

nodes.description: A number parameter scripts set (0 until one does).
nodes.label: Number Parameter

nodes.description: A true/false parameter scripts set (false until one does).
